This repo makes AI education accessible to everyone, from students to career changers, providing a solid foundation without needing prior experience. It's a perfect starting point for anyone curious about artificial intelligence.

items.summary_en: A Hacker News post titled "Elevators" has sparked a wide-ranging discussion about the technology behind vertical transportation. The conversation covers elevator dispatch algorithms, wait time optimization, and the emerging role of AI in modern elevator systems. While elevators seem mundane, they represent a fascinating intersection of mechanical engineering, control systems, and operations research. Smart elevator systems now use predictive algorithms and AI to anticipate traffic patterns and dynamically optimize car assignment, significantly reducing wait times in busy buildings. The discussion highlights how an overlooked everyday technology contains deep engineering challenges — from load balancing during rush hour to energy efficiency — making it a compelling topic for engineers and urban technology enthusiasts.

items.summary_en: This isn't a joke—it's a real dilemma many companies are facing. Uber's CTO revealed that over 90% of their engineers are using AI services heavily. Bosses are staring at the bills in shock: the technology that was supposed to reduce costs and boost efficiency has instead become a new money-burning black hole.

items.title: DeepSeek 居然会对用户说「我去吃饭了」「我去睡了」，为啥会出现这样的现象？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 对用户说出"我去吃饭了""我去睡了"，是因为模型在模拟人类社交惯例，而不是真的具备生理状态。这类拟人化输出通常由用户设定的人设、上下文中的角色扮演或网络语料中的高频表达触发，说明大模型的自我认知并不稳定。它提醒开发者，提示词中的角色设定会显著影响模型的回复边界。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek responding "I'm going to eat" or "I'm going to sleep" is a sign of the model mimicking human conversational routines, not actual awareness. These anthropomorphic replies occur when user-set personas, roleplay context, or chat-heavy training data steer the model. It reveals how unstable LLM self-identity can be and reminds developers that system prompts heavily shape output boundaries.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 flash 上线，相较 Kimi K3 各有哪些优劣？现版本大模型中你的选择是啥？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek V4 Flash 正式上线，主打低延迟和更低推理成本，官方在部分评测中与 Kimi K3 对标；Kimi K3 则在长上下文理解和复杂推理上保持优势。Flash 适合高频交互、对预算敏感的应用，K3 更适合深度分析和多步骤任务。开发者选型时需结合 context 长度、价格和真实业务场景，不宜只看跑分。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash has launched with a focus on low latency and reduced inference costs; official benchmarks put it near Kimi K3, while K3 retains an edge in long-context comprehension and complex reasoning. Flash suits high-frequency, cost-sensitive applications, whereas K3 fits deep-analysis or multi-step workflows. Developers should evaluate context windows, pricing, and their actual workload rather than relying solely on leaderboards.

items.title: sindresorhus/awesome
items.description: 😎 Awesome lists about all kinds of interesting topics
items.author: sindresorhus
items.summary_zh: 这是一个汇聚了各类有趣主题的精选列表合集，由开发者 sindresorhus 维护，涵盖从编程工具到生活百科的方方面面。项目以“Awesome”为名，已成为 GitHub 上发现优质资源的标准入口，无论你是想找框架、书籍还是学习资料，都能在这里找到社区推荐的宝藏。它的价值在于降低了信息筛选成本，让每个开发者都能快速触达高质量内容。
items.summary_en: This is a curated collection of awesome lists covering a vast range of interesting topics, maintained by developer sindresorhus. From programming tools to life hacks, the project has become the de facto gateway for discovering high-quality resources on GitHub. Whether you're looking for frameworks, books, or learning materials, the community-vetted lists save you hours of searching. Its significance lies in drastically reducing information filtering costs, making it an essential bookmark for any developer who wants quick access to the best content in any niche.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
items.author: obra
items.summary_zh: Superpowers 是一套面向 AI 代理的“技能框架”和软件开发方法论。它试图解决当前大模型在复杂任务中缺乏结构化思考的问题——通过定义清晰的技能单元和协作流程，让 AI 代理像人类工程师一样分步解决问题。这个框架不仅给 AI 用，也可以指导人类团队如何拆解需求、编写代码、进行测试。如果你在探索如何让 AI 更可靠地参与实际项目开发，或者想建立更高效的工程协作流程，值得关注。
items.summary_en: Superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology designed to make AI agents work more reliably on complex engineering tasks. Instead of letting a model guess its way through a problem, it decomposes work into defined skills, checks, and iterative steps—similar to how a senior engineer would approach a feature. The framework is practical enough to be used by human teams as well. If you're building AI-powered coding tools or want to inject disciplined structure into your development workflow, this project offers a fresh, actionable approach.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.author: affaan-m
items.summary_zh: affaan-m/ECC 是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex 和 Opencod 等 AI 编程助手的性能优化系统，它集成了技能、直觉、记忆、安全性和研究优先的开发理念，帮助开发者更高效地利用这些工具，让 AI 代理的运行更加稳定和智能。
items.summary_en: ECC is an agent harness performance optimization system designed for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Opencod. It bundles skills, instincts, memory, security, and a research-first development approach, enabling developers to fine-tune their agents for better stability and intelligence. This matters because it transforms raw AI tools into more reliable, context-aware programming partners.

items.title: ossu/computer-science
items.description: 🎓 Path to a free self-taught education in Computer Science!
items.author: ossu
items.summary_zh: OSSU是一个开源教育项目，它整合了全球顶尖大学的免费课程，形成一套完整的计算机科学自学路线。覆盖从算法到操作系统的核心知识，并且有社区支持。它让任何有决心的人都能像计算机专业学生一样系统学习，无需高昂学费，是追求扎实CS基础的自学者的绝佳路径。
items.summary_en: OSSU (Open Source Society University) curates a comprehensive, free, self-taught computer science curriculum based on courses from top universities like MIT and Stanford. It covers everything from discrete math to operating systems, providing a structured path that mirrors a traditional CS degree. With a supportive community, it's an excellent way for self-learners to gain a rigorous education without tuition costs.

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
items.author: mattpocock
items.summary_zh: 这个项目是著名 TypeScript 教育家 Matt Pocock 分享的一份“技能清单”，直接来自他的 AI 编程助手 Claude 的配置文件。它列出了他认为一名“真正工程师”应该掌握的核心能力——从代码审查、架构决策到技术债管理，覆盖了远比语法更重要的工程实践。与其说是代码库，不如说是一份工程文化的宣言。适合想提升团队工程水平或建立个人技术成长路线的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: This is Matt Pocock's personal skill list for 'real engineers,' extracted straight from his Claude AI configuration. It goes far beyond coding syntax to cover code review, architecture decisions, tech debt management, and communication—the soft and hard skills that separate experienced engineers from beginners. It's less a codebase and more a manifesto on engineering culture. If you're looking to level up your professional practice or define what 'good engineering' means for your team, this concise list is a great starting point.

items.title: firecrawl/firecrawl
items.description: The API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale. 🔥
items.author: firecrawl
items.summary_zh: Firecrawl是一款强大的网络API，专为开发者设计，能够高效地执行大规模的网络搜索、内容抓取和交互操作。它解决了传统爬虫工具在面对复杂网页和反爬机制时的痛点，提供了稳定且可扩展的数据采集能力。无论是数据科学家、AI训练团队还是需要实时信息的应用开发者，都能借助Firecrawl轻松获取结构化数据，从而加速产品迭代和研究进程。该工具的出现降低了网络数据获取的门槛，让智能应用更容易从海量网页中提取有价值的信息。
items.summary_en: Firecrawl is a powerful web API that enables developers to search, scrape, and interact with websites at scale. It solves common challenges like complex page structures and anti-bot measures, providing a reliable and scalable way to collect structured data. Data scientists, AI training teams, and application developers can use it to accelerate product iteration and research by extracting valuable information from massive web pages with ease. This tool lowers the barrier for web data acquisition, making it easier for intelligent applications to leverage real-time web content.

items.title: vercel/next.js
items.description: The React Framework
items.author: vercel
items.summary_zh: 由Vercel维护的Next.js是一个基于React的全栈框架，它通过服务端渲染、静态生成和文件路由等功能，极大简化了现代Web应用的构建流程。无论是个人开发者还是企业团队，都能利用它快速搭建高性能、SEO友好的网站。目前它已成为GitHub上最热门的React框架之一，活跃的社区和丰富的插件生态让开发体验更加流畅。
items.summary_en: Next.js, maintained by Vercel, is a React framework that simplifies building modern web apps with server-side rendering, static generation, and file-based routing. It solves performance and SEO challenges for React developers. Its popularity on GitHub reflects its ability to streamline workflows for both solo developers and large teams, making it a go-to choice for production-grade sites.

items.title: microsoft/PowerToys
items.description: Microsoft PowerToys is a collection of utilities that supercharge productivity and customization on Windows
items.author: microsoft
items.summary_zh: 微软推出的 PowerToys 是一套专为 Windows 用户打造的系统增强工具集，包含窗口管理、批量文件重命名、颜色选取等实用功能，旨在大幅提升日常操作效率与系统自定义能力。对于追求高效工作流和个性化体验的 Windows 发烧友来说，这套开源工具堪称生产力利器。
items.summary_en: Microsoft PowerToys is a set of open-source utilities designed to supercharge Windows productivity and customization. It includes tools like FancyZones for window management, PowerRename for bulk file renaming, and Color Picker, all aimed at streamlining everyday tasks and enhancing system personalization. Power users and developers will find it invaluable for optimizing their workflow and tailoring Windows to their needs.

items.title: anthropics/claude-code
items.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
items.author: anthropics
items.summary_zh: Claude Code 是一款驻扎在终端里的智能编码助手，它能深入理解你的整个代码库，替你执行那些繁琐的日常任务，比如重构、测试和文档编写，从而让你能专注于更重要的逻辑设计。对于那些希望在开发流程中大幅提升效率、减少重复劳动的开发者来说，这个工具就像给他们的终端装上了 AI 副驾驶，直接改变了人机协作的方式。
items.summary_en: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives right inside your terminal and understands your entire codebase, allowing it to automate routine tasks like refactoring, testing, and documentation. For developers tired of repetitive manual work, it acts as an AI co-pilot that accelerates development by handling the grunt work so you can focus on solving real problems. It's a practical, hands-on way to bring large language model assistance directly into your existing workflow, making coding faster and more enjoyable.

items.title: msitarzewski/agency-agents
items.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
items.author: msitarzewski
items.summary_zh: agency-agents是一个开源项目，提供了一套完整的AI代理团队，包括前端专家、社交媒体运营、创意注入者等各种角色。开发者可以通过简单的配置快速组建自己的AI“工作室”，无需从头训练每个模型。对于需要快速验证产品想法或自动化内容创作的个人和小团队来说，这个项目大大降低了AI应用的门槛，让每个人都能拥有一个虚拟的创业团队。
items.summary_en: Agency-agents is an open-source project that bundles a complete set of AI agents emulating a full-fledged digital agency. It includes roles like frontend wizards, Reddit community managers, and whimsy injectors, allowing developers to assemble a tailored AI team with minimal configuration. The beauty lies in its plug-and-play nature — you don't need to train each agent from scratch. For indie hackers, startup founders, and content creators, this means rapidly prototyping products or automating online presence without hiring a real team. It's a glimpse into a future where AI collaborates in structured, specialized groups.

items.title: 阿里急转向，快递大变局
items.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴突然调整快递业务战略，标志着快递行业迎来重大变局。过去阿里通过菜鸟网络整合物流生态，如今转向更轻量化的模式，可能放弃自建物流的重资产路线，转而聚焦平台化和技术赋能。这一转向不仅影响菜鸟的上市计划，也重新定义了电商与物流的关系，对于快递公司和商家来说，都需要重新评估合作模式。
items.summary_en: Alibaba has made a sudden strategic pivot in its delivery business, signaling a major shift in the logistics industry. Previously, the company relied on Cainiao Network to build an integrated logistics ecosystem, but now it is moving toward a lighter model, possibly abandoning heavy asset investments in favor of platform-based services and technology enablement. This change not only impacts Cainiao's IPO plans but also redefines the relationship between e-commerce and logistics, forcing delivery companies and merchants to rethink their partnerships.

items.title: 刚刚，Kimi K3开源，2.8万亿参数砸向全球，硅谷巨头看傻了
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面刚刚开源了其最新的Kimi K3模型，这个拥有2.8万亿参数的庞然大物直接向全球开发者开放，如此规模的参数数量让硅谷的科技巨头都感到震惊。开源意味着任何人都可以下载、研究甚至基于它构建自己的应用，这将极大地推动AI技术的民主化和创新速度。对于中国AI领域来说，这是一个从追随到引领的标志性事件。
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI has just open-sourced its latest Kimi K3 model, a massive 2.8 trillion parameter behemoth now available to developers worldwide. The sheer scale of its parameters has stunned Silicon Valley giants. By open-sourcing it, the company enables anyone to download, study, and build applications upon it, dramatically accelerating AI democratization and innovation. This marks a pivotal shift from follower to leader in China's AI landscape.

items.title: 一夜之间，GPT-5.6 来了，Codex 没了，Claude 急了
items.summary_zh: AI 领域在短短一夜之间发生了巨变：OpenAI 突然放出了 GPT-5.6，性能大幅提升，但同时宣布停用 Codex，这个曾为开发者熟知的代码生成工具。另一边，Anthropic 的 Claude 因为新模型压力倍增，似乎不得不加快迭代步伐来应对竞争。整个行业节奏快得让人应接不暇，开发者需要迅速适应新工具。
items.summary_en: The AI landscape shifted overnight: OpenAI released GPT-5.6 with significant performance gains, yet simultaneously discontinued Codex, the well-known code generation tool. Meanwhile, Anthropic's Claude faces mounting pressure from the new release, likely forcing faster iterations to stay competitive. This rapid evolution demands developers quickly adapt to new tools, highlighting the breakneck pace of AI model competition.

items.title: 4小时、11个话题、118次回答，梁文锋内部交流回应一切
items.summary_zh: 36氪热门：4小时、11个话题、118次回答，梁文锋内部交流回应一切
items.summary_en: Popular on 36Kr: 4小时、11个话题、118次回答，梁文锋内部交流回应一切

items.title: DeepSeek V4“满血版”曝光了，最快明天发布
items.summary_zh: 据 36 氪独家消息，DeepSeek V4 的“满血版”即将在明天发布，这意味着这款国产大模型将迎来一次重大升级。新版本在推理、多轮对话和代码生成等能力上预计会有显著提升，甚至可能直接对标 GPT-4 级别的性能。对于国内 AI 开发者和企业用户来说，这不仅是技术突破的信号，更可能带来更低价、更高效率的落地应用，加速行业智能化转型。
items.summary_en: According to an exclusive report from 36Kr, the full-powered version of DeepSeek V4 is set to drop as soon as tomorrow, marking a major upgrade for this Chinese large language model. The new release is expected to bring substantial improvements in reasoning, multi-turn dialogue, and code generation, potentially rivaling GPT-4-level performance. For domestic AI developers and enterprise users, this signals a technological breakthrough that could lead to more cost-effective and efficient real-world applications, accelerating the intelligent transformation of various industries.

items.title: 团灭，大厂集体下架AI聊天机器人
items.summary_zh: 近日，多家大型科技公司集体下架了自家的AI聊天机器人产品，引发行业广泛关注。这些厂商包括国内头部互联网企业，下架原因疑似与内容安全、数据隐私以及监管合规压力有关。此举意味着在AI技术快速落地的同时，厂商们开始主动收缩风险边界，优先确保产品合规。对于用户而言，这可能会暂时减少可用的AI对话工具，但也预示着行业正从野蛮生长转向规范化发展，长期来看有利于建立更可信的AI生态。
items.summary_en: Several major tech companies have collectively taken down their AI chatbot products, raising eyebrows across the industry. The removals, involving top Chinese internet firms, are believed to be driven by content safety, data privacy concerns, and mounting regulatory compliance pressures. This move signals that as AI technology rapidly deploys, companies are proactively shrinking risk boundaries to prioritize legal compliance. For users, it may temporarily reduce available AI conversational tools, but it also indicates a shift from wild growth toward standardization, which in the long run could foster a more trustworthy AI ecosystem.

items.title: 惊天巨骗，一夜刷爆全球榜单的「神秘实验室」，竟然是假的
items.summary_zh: 近日，一个号称“神秘实验室”的项目一夜之间刷爆全球科技榜单，但随后被揭露为一场精心策划的骗局。该实验室声称取得了突破性技术成果，吸引大量关注和投资，实则并无实际产品。这一事件引发了对科技投资泡沫和榜单操纵的广泛讨论，警示业界需加强尽职调查。
items.summary_en: A mysterious 'lab' project recently topped global tech charts overnight, only to be exposed as an elaborate scam. The project claimed groundbreaking technological achievements, attracting massive attention and investment, but had no real product. This incident has sparked widespread discussion about tech investment bubbles and ranking manipulation, serving as a cautionary tale for the industry to strengthen due diligence. It highlights the dangers of hype and the need for critical evaluation in the tech community.

items.title: 中国企业出手，欧洲爽了
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了中国企业近期在欧洲的一系列投资与并购动作，让欧洲市场感到振奋。从新能源到高端制造，中国资本正以更加积极的姿态参与欧洲产业升级，为当地带来就业和技术合作机会。这种双向奔赴不仅帮助中国企业拓展全球布局，也让欧洲在低迷经济中找到了新的增长引擎，实现了真正的互利共赢。
items.summary_en: The article discusses how recent investments and acquisitions by Chinese companies in Europe have buoyed the European economy. From renewable energy to high-end manufacturing, Chinese capital is actively participating in Europe's industrial upgrade, creating jobs and fostering tech collaboration. This two-way engagement not only helps Chinese firms expand globally but also gives Europe a much-needed growth engine amid economic sluggishness, embodying a genuine win-win partnership.

items.title: 小亏大赚，普通人的凸性投资完整路径
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了适合普通人的“凸性投资”策略，即通过承担有限的小亏损来追求大概率的大收益。它解释了凸性在投资中的含义，并提供了完整的操作路径。对于追求长期稳健回报、不愿承受重大损失的散户投资者来说，它提供了一种科学的风险管理思路，帮助他们在不确定的市场中实现“小亏大赚”。
items.summary_en: This article introduces the concept of 'convex investing' for ordinary people, a strategy where one accepts small, limited losses in exchange for the potential of large, asymmetric gains. It explains convexity in finance and outlines a complete investment pathway. Targeted at retail investors seeking steady long-term returns while avoiding catastrophic losses, it offers a disciplined risk management framework to achieve higher reward-to-risk ratios and navigate market uncertainty.

items.title: 一年赚走中国女人近5亿，曾被抛弃的性感巨头，重回第一
items.summary_zh: 曾因风格过于性感而被市场边缘化的某女性品牌，如今凭借精准的品牌重塑和产品升级，重新夺回行业第一宝座，一年内从中国女性消费者身上赚走近5亿元。它的逆袭故事展示了传统品牌如何在消费趋势变迁中灵活调整策略，抓住新一代女性的审美和需求红利，也印证了“性感”并非过时，而是需要与品质和情感共鸣结合。
items.summary_en: A once-dominant women's brand that was sidelined for being too sexy has staged a remarkable comeback, reclaiming the top spot in its industry and earning nearly 500 million yuan from Chinese female consumers in a single year. Through precise brand reinvention and product upgrades, it adapted to shifting consumer trends, capturing the aesthetic and emotional needs of a new generation. The story demonstrates that traditional brands can thrive by blending boldness with quality and resonance, proving that 'sexy' is far from outdated.

items.title: 史上最高调的AI重写：Claude花11天搞定Bun，创始人花一个月才敢交底
items.summary_zh: Anthropic的Claude AI在11天内重写了JavaScript运行时Bun的核心代码，但创始人Jarred Sumner花了一个月才敢对外公布这个消息。这个案例展示了AI在大型软件重写中的惊人效率和潜力，但同时也引发了关于代码质量、可维护性和安全风险的讨论。Sumner的谨慎态度反映出业界对AI生成代码缺乏足够信任和验证机制的现实。这件事给企业带来启示：AI重写可以大幅缩短开发周期，但必须配合严格的代码审查和测试流程，才能真正放心使用。
items.summary_en: Anthropic's Claude AI rewrote the core of Bun, a JavaScript runtime, in just 11 days, but founder Jarred Sumner waited a month before revealing it. This case highlights both the incredible speed of AI-driven code rewriting and the accompanying concerns over quality, maintainability, and security. Sumner's caution reflects the industry's lack of trust and verification mechanisms for AI-generated code. The takeaway for enterprises is that while AI can dramatically shorten development cycles, it must be paired with rigorous code review and testing before deployment can be fully trusted.

items.title: 从零开始预训练，蚂蚁灵波发布具身原生世界动作模型LingBot-VA 2.0
items.summary_zh: 蚂蚁集团旗下灵波团队近日发布了全新的具身原生世界动作模型LingBot-VA 2.0，和以往依赖仿真环境或迁移学习的方案不同，这次他们从零开始预训练这个模型，让机器人能更加自主地理解物理世界并执行复杂动作。这意味着机器人不再需要大量人工标注和场景适配，可以更快适应真实环境的变化。对于工业自动化和服务机器人领域来说，这个模型有望大幅降低部署成本，提升泛化能力，是具身智能走向实用化的重要一步。
items.summary_en: Ant Group's Lingbo team has released LingBot-VA 2.0, an embodied native world action model trained from scratch rather than relying on simulation or transfer learning. This approach allows robots to better understand physical environments and perform complex actions without extensive manual annotation or scene adaptation. The model significantly improves generalization and reduces deployment costs, making it a crucial step toward practical embodied intelligence in industrial automation and service robotics.

items.title: GPT-5.6全面围剿Claude Fable 5，“超级应用”ChatGPT Work上位，Altman紧急澄清：不会取代Coedx
items.summary_zh: OpenAI推出的GPT-5.6模型正全面对标并压制Anthropic的Claude Fable 5，同时将ChatGPT Work打造成集办公、创作于一体的“超级应用”。面对外界关于它会取代现有开发者工具Coedx的猜测，Sam Altman紧急澄清，称两者定位不同，ChatGPT Work专注于通用生产力，不会替代专业的代码开发平台。这一消息在开发者社区引发热议，反映了AI巨头在应用层争夺用户的激烈竞争。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 model is going head-to-head with Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, while turning ChatGPT Work into a 'super app' that integrates office productivity and creative tasks. Amid speculation that it might replace existing developer tools like Coedx, Sam Altman quickly clarified that ChatGPT Work targets general productivity and won't replace specialized coding platforms. This news has sparked heated debate among developers, reflecting the intense competition among AI giants at the application layer.

items.title: GitHub 的旧模式被 AI 击穿，Cursor、GitLab、Zed 各自开打
items.summary_zh: GitHub原有的代码托管与协作模式正被AI浪潮彻底颠覆，Cursor、GitLab和Zed等新工具纷纷发力，各自以AI辅助编程、智能协作和轻量编辑器等不同路线争夺开发者。这场变革之所以重要，是因为AI让代码生成、审查和合并变得高度自动化，传统基于Pull Request的工作流可能被重新定义。开发者和团队需要重新思考如何更高效地协同编码。
items.summary_en: GitHub's traditional code hosting and collaboration model is being disrupted by AI, with tools like Cursor, GitLab, and Zed each taking different approaches—AI-assisted coding, smart collaboration, and lightweight editing—to win over developers. This shift matters because AI automates code generation, review, and merging, potentially redefining the classic pull-request workflow. Developers and teams must rethink how to collaborate efficiently in this new landscape.

items.title: AI时代最被低估的创业资本，不是技术，是你的“老本行”
items.summary_zh: 在AI创业热潮中，技术往往被奉为第一生产力，但本文提出一个反直觉的观点：真正的创业资本不是算法或算力，而是你在进入AI之前积累的行业经验，也就是“老本行”。作者以多个成功案例说明，懂业务的创业者能更准确识别AI落地的痛点，避免技术堆砌的陷阱。对于正在寻找方向的AI创业者来说，这篇文章提供了一个冷静的提醒——与其追风口，不如回归自己最熟悉的领域深耕。
items.summary_en: Amid the AI startup frenzy, an InfoQ article argues that the most underrated entrepreneurial capital is not cutting-edge technology but your prior industry expertise—your 'old trade.' Through real-world cases, it shows that founders with deep domain knowledge can better identify pain points and avoid over-engineering solutions. The piece offers a grounded perspective for AI entrepreneurs: instead of chasing hype, they should leverage their unique backgrounds to build truly valuable applications.

items.title: HubSpot 如何将语义搜索扩展至 200 亿个向量
items.summary_zh: HubSpot公开了他们如何将语义搜索系统扩展到支持200亿个向量的技术历程。面对海量数据的检索挑战，他们通过分片策略、量化优化和合理的索引设计，在保证低延迟和高召回率的前提下，成功支撑了大规模语义搜索。这个案例对任何需要构建或扩容向量搜索系统的团队都具有参考价值，尤其是在实际工程中如何平衡精度、性能和成本，HubSpot的经验提供了宝贵的实战指南。
items.summary_en: HubSpot has shared how it scaled its semantic search system to support 20 billion vectors. The engineering team employed sharding, quantization, and optimized indexing to achieve low latency and high recall at this massive scale. The case study provides practical guidance on balancing precision, performance, and cost, making it a valuable reference for any team building or expanding vector search infrastructure in production.

items.title: Agent 进化论：从对话到协作
items.summary_zh: 智能体（Agent）正在经历一场进化，从最初的简单对话交互走向多智能体之间的深度协作。这一转变意味着AI不再只是被动应答，而是能够主动理解任务、拆解目标，并与其他Agent协同工作以完成复杂流程。对于企业而言，这种协作能力将极大提升自动化水平，尤其适用于需要多个系统或角色配合的场景，如供应链管理、客户服务闭环等。
items.summary_en: AI agents are evolving from mere conversational interfaces into collaborative entities capable of working together to achieve complex goals. This shift enables agents to understand tasks, break them down, and coordinate with other agents, moving beyond simple Q&A to orchestrate multi-step workflows. For businesses, this means higher automation potential in areas like supply chain management and customer service, where multiple systems and roles must interact seamlessly. The trend signals a future where AI becomes a true team player rather than a solitary tool.

items.title: 从PostgreSQL切换到ClickHouse，提升系统性能与伸缩性
items.summary_zh: 一家技术团队分享了从PostgreSQL迁移到ClickHouse的真实案例，详细描述了切换过程中遇到的性能瓶颈、数据一致性问题和伸缩性挑战，以及最终的解决思路。ClickHouse在高并发分析查询和实时聚合方面表现出色，显著提升了系统吞吐量和响应速度。对于正在遭遇PostgreSQL在分析场景下性能不足的团队，这篇文章给出了有说服力的对比数据和具体的落地经验，帮助读者判断何时以及如何切换到列式存储引擎。
items.summary_en: A technical team recounts their migration from PostgreSQL to ClickHouse, detailing the performance bottlenecks, consistency issues, and scalability challenges they faced. By switching to the columnar store, they achieved dramatic improvements in query throughput and response time for real-time analytical workloads. The article provides benchmarking data and practical migration tips, making it a valuable resource for teams evaluating whether and how to move from a row-based to a column-based database for analytics.

items.title: 微软、Meta 同日交财报：小扎把现金流烧到只剩7.84亿美元，纳德拉靠 Azure 赚疯了
Snowflake CoWork：每位知识工作者的专属工作 Agent ｜ 技术趋势
items.summary_zh: Snowflake CoWork是一款专为知识工作者设计的智能工作代理，它利用大语言模型和自动化技术，帮助用户处理文档、数据分析和协作任务。其核心价值在于将重复性工作自动化，让知识工作者能专注于更具创造性的决策。对于数据分析师、产品经理和科研人员而言，CoWork就像一位随时待命的数字助手，显著提升工作效率。
items.summary_en: Snowflake CoWork is a dedicated AI agent tailored for knowledge workers, designed to automate complex workflows involving documents, data analysis, and collaboration. By leveraging large language models, it handles repetitive tasks and provides intelligent assistance, allowing professionals to focus on high-level decisions. This tool is a game-changer for analysts, product managers, and researchers who constantly juggle multiple data sources and documents. Its significance lies in reducing cognitive load and accelerating routine processes, making it a natural evolution of productivity tools in the age of AI.

items.title: Show HN: I replaced a $120k bowling center system with $1,600 in ESP32s
items.author: section33
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者用总价仅1600美元的ESP32微控制器，成功替代了原本价值12万美元的保龄球中心管理系统。这个项目展示了如何利用低成本硬件和巧妙的软件设计，实现计分、传感器联动和用户管理等核心功能。对于小型保龄球馆经营者或喜欢DIY的嵌入式爱好者来说，这是一个极具启发性的低成本自动化改造案例。
items.summary_en: A developer replaced a $120,000 bowling center management system with just $1,600 worth of ESP32 microcontrollers. The project demonstrates how low-cost hardware and clever software design can handle core functions like scoring, sensor integration, and user management. For small bowling alley operators or embedded systems enthusiasts, this is an inspiring example of how to achieve professional-grade automation on a shoestring budget.

items.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
items.author: vincent_s
items.summary_zh: Kimi K3 是一款开源前沿智能模型，旨在将最先进的AI能力开放给更多开发者和研究者。它解决了闭源AI技术垄断的问题，让社区能够自由实验、定制和改进模型。无论是初创公司还是学术机构，都能借助Kimi K3构建自己的智能应用，而无需支付昂贵的授权费用。这种开放策略有望加速AI创新和民主化，使得更广泛的人群能享受到人工智能的成果。
items.summary_en: Kimi K3 is an open-source frontier intelligence model designed to democratize state-of-the-art AI capabilities. It tackles the problem of closed-source AI monopolies by allowing developers and researchers to freely experiment, customize, and improve the model. Startups and academic institutions, in particular, can build their own intelligent applications without expensive licensing fees. This open approach is expected to accelerate AI innovation and democratization, making advanced artificial intelligence accessible to a broader audience.

items.title: Claude Opus 5
items.author: alvis
items.summary_zh: Claude Opus 5是Anthropic最新发布的大型语言模型，据称在推理、代码生成和多轮对话能力上实现了显著飞跃。相比前代，它更擅长处理长上下文和复杂指令，同时保持了较高的安全性。对于需要强大AI助手进行编程、写作及分析的开发者与研究者来说，这代表了一项重要的生产力提升工具。
items.summary_en: Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's latest large language model, boasting major improvements in reasoning, code generation, and multi-turn conversation. It handles longer contexts and complex instructions more adeptly while maintaining strong safety guardrails. For developers and researchers seeking a powerful AI assistant for coding, writing, and analysis, this release marks a significant leap in productivity.

items.title: Apple sues OpenAI, accuses ex-employees of stealing trade secrets
items.author: stock_toaster
items.summary_zh: 苹果公司近日对OpenAI提起民事诉讼，指控多名前员工在离职时窃取了与人工智能研发相关的商业机密。这些员工据称带走了内部技术文档和核心算法，并可能用于竞争项目。这起诉讼不仅反映了硅谷两大科技巨头在人才和知识产权上的激烈争夺，也凸显了AI领域日益敏感的技术保密问题。对于科技行业观察者而言，这场法律战的结果或许会重塑企业防范员工跳槽时的保密协议设计。
items.summary_en: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that several former employees stole trade secrets related to artificial intelligence research. The complaint claims these workers took proprietary technical documents and core algorithms before leaving for positions that could benefit competing projects. This legal battle underscores the fierce competition for talent and intellectual property between two Silicon Valley giants, and highlights the growing sensitivity of technology secrecy in the AI industry. For tech observers, the outcome may influence how companies craft confidentiality agreements to guard against employee poaching.

items.title: Show HN: Elevators
items.author: Jrh0203

items.title: EU Parliament greenlights Chat Control 1.0
items.author: rapnie
items.summary_zh: 欧盟议会通过了备受争议的Chat Control 1.0法案，要求数字平台扫描并报告涉及儿童性虐待材料的私密通信内容。这项立法引发了隐私与安全之间的激烈辩论，支持者认为它有助于保护儿童，而反对者警告这可能破坏端到端加密并开创大规模监控的先例。对于关注数字权利和隐私保护的群体来说，这是一个需要密切关注的发展。
items.summary_en: The European Parliament has approved the controversial Chat Control 1.0 regulation, requiring digital platforms to scan private communications for child sexual abuse material. The law sparks intense debate between child safety advocates and privacy defenders, who warn it undermines end-to-end encryption and sets a precedent for mass surveillance. Anyone concerned about digital rights and encryption should pay close attention to this development.

items.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face address security incident during model evaluation
items.author: mfiguiere
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Hugging Face 联合披露了一起在模型评估过程中发现的安全事件，涉及潜在的数据泄露风险。两家公司迅速响应，修补了漏洞并加强了评估流程的防护措施。这一事件突显了 AI 模型评估环节的安全性不容忽视，特别是在第三方协作和开放测试环境中，更需要建立严格的安全审查机制。
items.summary_en: OpenAI and Hugging Face disclosed a security incident that occurred during a model evaluation, involving potential data exposure risks. Both companies responded quickly, patching the vulnerability and reinforcing security protocols in the evaluation pipeline. This incident highlights that AI model evaluation stages are not immune to attacks, especially in collaborative and open-testing environments, underscoring the need for rigorous security review processes to protect sensitive data.

items.title: GPT-5.6
items.author: logickkk1
items.summary_zh: 关于GPT-5.6的传闻在开发者社区悄然升温，据称这是OpenAI内部测试的新一代模型，在推理效率和长文本处理上有显著提升。尽管官方未确认，但泄露的基准测试显示其在复杂编程和数学任务上超越了现有版本。如果属实，这将意味着AI模型在实用性和响应速度上迈入新台阶，对依赖语言模型的开发者和企业影响深远。
items.summary_en: Rumors about GPT-5.6, an alleged internal iteration from OpenAI, have sparked excitement in the developer community. Leaked benchmarks suggest it offers substantial improvements in reasoning efficiency and long-context handling, outperforming current models on complex coding and math tasks. While OpenAI hasn't confirmed the release, the speculation points to a possible leap in practical AI utility, making responses faster and more accurate. For developers and businesses relying on language models, even incremental upgrades can translate into better user experiences and lower latency. This potential release underscores the rapid pace of AI advancement.

items.title: Decoding the obfuscated bash script on a Uniqlo t-shirt
items.author: speerer
items.summary_zh: 一位技术爱好者解析了优衣库T恤上印制的混淆bash脚本，发现它实际上是一个恶作剧程序，通过复杂的字符串操作和陷阱逻辑来隐藏其真实功能。这篇分析展示了逆向工程乐趣，也提醒大家即使看似无害的代码也可能暗藏玄机。对于安全研究人员和编程爱好者来说，这是一次趣味与技术并重的解谜之旅。
items.summary_en: A tech enthusiast meticulously dissected an obfuscated bash script printed on a Uniqlo t-shirt, revealing it to be a playful prank program designed to confuse casual observers. The script uses intricate string manipulations and trap commands to mask its true purpose, which is simply to echo a message. This analysis highlights the fun side of reverse engineering and serves as a reminder that even innocuous-looking code can contain hidden complexity. It's a delightful read for security researchers and programming hobbyists who enjoy a good puzzle.

items.title: Writing by hand is good for your brain
items.author: dwwoelfel
items.summary_zh: 最新的神经科学研究再次证实，手写比打字更能激活大脑中负责学习和记忆的区域。当人们用笔在纸上写字时，手部精细动作与视觉、空间感知的协同作用能加深对信息的处理，从而提升理解和长期记忆。对于学生、创意工作者以及任何希望提高学习效率的人来说，暂时放下键盘、拿起纸笔可能是一种简单而有效的认知训练。
items.summary_en: Recent neuroscience research reaffirms that handwriting engages the brain's learning and memory centers far more deeply than typing. The coordinated fine motor movements, visual feedback, and spatial awareness involved in putting pen to paper enhance information processing, leading to better comprehension and long-term retention. For students, creatives, and anyone seeking to learn more effectively, this suggests that swapping the keyboard for a notebook now and then is a simple yet powerful cognitive boost.

items.title: OpenSEO
items.description: The open source Ahrefs alternative
items.summary_zh: OpenSEO是一款开源的SEO分析工具，被称作Ahrefs的免费替代品。它提供了网站爬取、关键词研究、外链分析和排名跟踪等核心功能，所有数据都存储在本地，无需订阅付费服务。对于中小企业主、独立博主以及预算有限的网络营销人员来说，OpenSEO让他们能够以零成本获得专业级的搜索引擎优化洞察，帮助他们发现内容机会、监控竞争对手并提升网站流量。开源社区的支持也确保了工具的持续更新和功能扩展。
items.summary_en: OpenSEO is an open-source SEO toolkit marketed as a free alternative to Ahrefs. It includes website crawling, keyword research, backlink analysis, and rank tracking, all running locally so no subscription or third-party service is needed. This empowers small business owners, independent bloggers, and budget-conscious marketers to access professional-level SEO insights at zero cost, helping them discover content opportunities, monitor competitors, and boost organic traffic. Because the community drives its development, OpenSEO is continuously improved and extended, making it a practical choice for those who want full control over their SEO data without recurring fees.

items.title: ClawTeams
items.description: The first goal-driven, proactive AI team for e-commerce
items.summary_zh: ClawTeams 是首个面向电商的目标驱动型主动AI团队。它不像传统工具那样被动等待指令，而是自主分析店铺数据，主动制定运营目标并自动执行，比如优化广告投放、调整库存或提升转化率。对于忙于日常运营的电商卖家来说，ClawTeams就像一位不知疲倦的运营总监，帮助商家在复杂竞争中更高效地达成销售目标。
items.summary_en: ClawTeams is the first goal-driven, proactive AI team built specifically for e-commerce. Instead of waiting for manual commands, it autonomously analyzes store data, sets objectives, and takes actions—like optimizing ad spend, adjusting inventory, or boosting conversions. For busy e-commerce merchants drowning in daily operations, ClawTeams acts like a tireless operations director, helping them hit sales targets more efficiently in a competitive landscape.

items.title: Paradigm
items.description: Turn any goal into a personalized, adaptive learning path.
items.summary_zh: Paradigm 是一款能将任何目标转化为个性化自适应学习路径的工具。它利用AI分析用户的知识水平和学习习惯，动态调整学习计划，帮助用户高效达成既定目标。不同于传统的固定课程，Paradigm能够识别用户的薄弱环节并提供针对性内容。对于想要系统学习新技能或准备考试的人来说，它提供了一种灵活且高效的解决方案，极大提升了学习的自主性和效率。
items.summary_en: Paradigm turns any goal into a personalized, adaptive learning path by leveraging AI to analyze a user's knowledge level and learning habits, dynamically adjusting the plan to help them achieve their target efficiently. Unlike fixed curricula, Paradigm identifies weak spots and delivers tailored content. This makes it a flexible and effective solution for anyone wanting to systematically learn a new skill or prepare for exams, significantly boosting autonomy and learning efficiency.

items.title: Pazi
items.description: Vibe code business operations
items.summary_zh: Pazi 提出了一种全新的业务运营方式——“氛围代码”，即用类似编程的思维和工具来编排业务流程，但操作界面友好直观，不需要传统编码背景。它让团队可以通过定义“氛围”或模式来自动化审批、任务分配等日常操作，使运营更加灵活、透明且易于调整。适合希望用轻量自动化提升效率的业务团队，尤其适合初创公司。
items.summary_en: Pazi introduces 'vibe code' for business operations—a fresh approach that lets you orchestrate workflows using programming-like logic through an intuitive interface, without actual coding. Teams define 'vibes' or patterns to automate approvals, task assignments, and more, making operations flexible, transparent, and easy to tweak. It's ideal for small teams and startups seeking lightweight automation to streamline daily processes without heavy engineering overhead.

items.title: ExploreYC
items.description: Open-source API for Y Combinator & a16z company data
items.summary_zh: ExploreYC是一个开源API，提供了Y Combinator和a16z投资组合公司的结构化数据访问，包括公司名称、简介、融资轮次和创始团队信息。创业者、投资者和研究人员可以通过该API轻松获取这些顶级孵化器和风投的公开数据，用于市场分析、竞品研究或个人项目。开源特性使得任何人都可以部署或扩展这个数据服务。
items.summary_en: ExploreYC is an open-source API that provides structured access to data from Y Combinator and a16z portfolio companies, including company names, descriptions, funding rounds, and founder details. Entrepreneurs, investors, and researchers can easily retrieve this publicly available data for market analysis, competitive research, or personal projects. Its open-source nature allows anyone to deploy or extend the data service.

items.title: ChatCut
items.description: Your AI video editor in ChatGPT, desktop, and web
items.summary_zh: ChatCut是一款集成在ChatGPT、桌面端和网页端的AI视频编辑器。用户只需用自然语言描述剪辑需求，AI就能自动完成剪切、转场和特效添加等操作。它大幅降低了视频制作的门槛，适合内容创作者和普通用户快速生成高质量视频内容，无需学习专业软件。
items.summary_en: ChatCut is an AI-powered video editor accessible through ChatGPT, desktop app, and web browser. Users simply describe their editing needs in natural language, and the AI handles cutting, transitions, and effects automatically. This significantly lowers the barrier for video creation, making it ideal for content creators and casual users who want professional results without mastering complex editing software.

items.title: Auriko
items.description: Trading desk for LLM calls
items.summary_zh: Auriko是一个专为大模型调用设计的交易平台，它让开发者能够像交易股票一样买卖LLM的API调用配额。通过这个平台，你可以灵活地管理和优化模型调用成本，在高峰期买入更多调用次数，在低谷时出售多余配额。对于经常使用多个大模型API的团队来说，Auriko提供了一种全新的成本控制方式，让资源分配更加经济和高效。
items.summary_en: Auriko is a trading desk designed specifically for LLM API calls, allowing developers to buy and sell call quotas just like stocks. This platform enables flexible cost management and resource allocation—purchase more calls during peak demand and sell excess during lulls. For teams that rely on multiple large language models, Auriko offers a novel way to optimize spending and ensure efficient usage, making it a compelling tool for cost-conscious AI developers.

items.title: V2Fun
items.description: Generate 3D character with 8K textures and AI motion capture
items.summary_zh: V2Fun是一款面向创作者和游戏开发者的3D角色生成工具，它能通过AI自动生成具有8K纹理的高质量3D角色模型，并内置AI动作捕捉功能，让角色立刻拥有流畅的动画。过去，制作一个类似的精细角色需要专业的建模师、纹理艺术家和动捕设备，耗时数天甚至数周；而V2Fun将这一过程缩短到几分钟，大幅降低了3D内容创作的门槛。无论是独立游戏制作者、虚拟主播，还是电商展示中的数字人形象，都能借助它快速生成可用资产。
items.summary_en: V2Fun is a 3D character generation tool that uses AI to produce high-quality models with 8K textures and includes AI-powered motion capture for instant animation. What once required a team of professional modelers, texture artists, and expensive motion capture equipment—taking days or weeks—can now be done in minutes. This dramatically lowers the barrier for independent game developers, virtual streamers, and digital human creators in e-commerce, enabling them to quickly generate production-ready characters without specialized skills. It solves the bottleneck of 3D asset creation: speed versus quality.

items.title: AgentKey
items.description: One-stop live data marketplace for your agent
items.summary_zh: AgentKey是一个专为AI代理打造的一站式实时数据交易市场，它让代理能够像在超市购物一样轻松获取各类实时数据。无论是天气、股价还是新闻，开发者只需通过API就能为他们的智能体接入高质量数据流，大大降低了数据获取的门槛和成本。对于正在构建需要实时信息响应的AI应用的人来说，这个平台相当于给代理装上了永不停歇的信息触角。
items.summary_en: AgentKey is a one-stop live data marketplace designed specifically for AI agents, allowing them to purchase real-time data streams as easily as buying groceries. It solves the perennial problem of agents needing up-to-date information by providing a unified API where developers can subscribe to everything from weather to stock prices. This platform is a game-changer for anyone building autonomous agents that require live data, eliminating the hassle of integrating multiple data sources and reducing both cost and complexity.

items.title: Osaurus
items.description: Open source agents that run 100% locally on your Mac
items.summary_zh: Osaurus是一款全新的开源工具，让你的Mac能完全在本地运行AI智能体，无需连接互联网或依赖第三方云服务。它利用本地计算资源处理任务，从自动化文件管理到辅助编程皆可胜任，所有数据都保留在你的设备上，确保隐私安全。对于注重数据主权和离线工作流的开发者与普通用户而言，这款工具极具吸引力。Osaurus的开源属性还允许社区自由定制和优化，可能成为本地AI落地的重要推手。
items.summary_en: Osaurus is an open-source tool that enables you to run AI agents entirely locally on your Mac, with no internet connection or cloud dependencies required. It leverages your device's own computing power to handle tasks ranging from file management automation to coding assistance, keeping all data on your machine for maximum privacy. This makes it especially appealing to developers and privacy-conscious users who value data sovereignty and offline workflows. Being open-source, Osaurus also invites community customization and improvement, positioning itself as a potential game-changer for bringing practical, local AI to everyday computing.

items.summary_en: An insomniac developer built a typhoon tracking website for Typhoon Bavi using Claude Fable 5 in the early hours. He aggregated path data from four weather agencies—China's Central Meteorological Observatory, Japan Meteorological Agency, US Joint Typhoon Warning Center, and Taiwan's Central Weather Bureau—onto a single map, making discrepancies instantly visible. This project demonstrates AI-assisted programming's potential and the value of data aggregation in weather education.

items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了如何设计一个优秀的AI技能系统，重点介绍了“具身交互智能”这一前沿概念，即让AI拥有身体并能感知世界、理解环境、通过语音表情动作与人自然互动。这一设计理念将推动AI从纯语言模型向多模态、有实体的智能体进化，解决AI在物理世界中行动和感知的难题，对开发者设计下一代人机交互产品具有重要启发意义。
items.summary_en: This article explores how to design an excellent AI skills system, focusing on the cutting-edge concept of 'embodied interactive intelligence.' It argues that the next phase of AI goes beyond reasoning—AI should have a body, perceive the world, understand environments, and interact through voice, expressions, and gestures. This approach solves the problem of AI operating in physical spaces, enabling more natural human-machine collaboration. Developers building the next generation of smart assistants, robots, or metaverse avatars will find these design principles transformative.
